Darkthrone

Country of origin:
Norway
Location:
Kolbotn, N. Follo, Akershus (early); Oslo (mid); Vinterbro, Ås, Akershus / Trysil, Innlandet (later)
Status:
Active
Formed in:
1987
Genre:
Death Metal (early); Black Metal (mid); Black/Doom/Heavy/Speed Metal (later)
Themes:
Anti-religion, Satan, Occultism, Death, Rebellion, Metal
Current label:
Peaceville Records
Years active:
1986-1987 (as Black Death), 1987-present
Darkthrone started as a death metal band, but by the end of 1990 and the beginning of 1991, when they were rehearsing the material that would eventually become Goatlord, Nocturno Culto, Zephyrous, and Fenriz developed interest in black metal. Soon they decided to abort the Goatlord sessions because the material didn't reflect what they felt, and started to compose the songs that were to be found ...
